name: 陸一平
objective:
本課程深入探討人工智慧領域的基礎知識和最新技術，包括機器學習、深度學習、自然語言處理、生成對抗網絡等領域。學員將從人工智慧的概述和歷史開始，逐步深入了解機器學習和深度學習的基礎概念和演算法，並探討其在不同領域的應用。課程還介紹了最新的 AI 技術趨勢，包括注意力機制、自監督學習、大型 AI 通用模型和元學習等。
課程運作模式：每週講授一個主題，包括理論授課和實習操作。學員將參與課堂討論和小組活動，以促進想法交流和知識分享。
This course delves into the fundamentals and latest advancements in the field of artificial intelligence, covering topics such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and generative adversarial networks. Participants will begin with an overview of artificial intelligence and its historical development, progressively delving into the foundational concepts and algorithms of machine learning and deep learning, along with their applications across various domains. The course also introduces the latest trends in AI technology, including attention mechanisms, self-supervised learning, large-scale AI models, and meta-learning.
Course Execution: Each week covers a specific topic, including theoretical lectures and practical exercises. Participants will engage in classroom discussions and group activities to facilitate idea exchange and knowledge sharing.
schedule:
第 1 週：人工智慧導論與歷史發展
Week 1: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Historical Background

第 2 週：資料科學與資料前處理
Week 2: Data Science and Preprocessing

第 3 週：特徵工程與資料可視化
Week 3: Feature Engineering and Data Visualization

第 4 週：監督式學習基礎
Week 4: Fundamentals of Supervised Learning

第 5 週：非監督式學習與群集分析
Week 5: Unsupervised Learning and Clustering Analysis

第 6 週：模型評估與交叉驗證
Week 6: Model Evaluation and Cross-Validation

第 7 週：深度學習基礎與多層感知器

第 8 週：卷積神經網路（CNN）
Week 8: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)

第 9 週：循環神經網路與長短期記憶（RNN & LSTM）
Week 9: Recurrent Neural Networks and LSTM

第 10 週：自然語言處理與語意表示
Week 10: Natural Language Processing and Semantic Representations

第 11 週：生成對抗網絡（GAN）原理與應用
Week 11: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) – Principles and Applications

第 12 週：注意力機制與 Transformer 架構
Week 12: Attention Mechanisms and Transformer Architecture

第 13 週：自監督學習理論與方法
Week 13: Self-Supervised Learning – Theory and Methods

第 14 週：大型語言模型與多模態系統
Week 14: Large Language Models and Multimodal AI Systems

第 15 週：元學習與自適應人工智慧
Week 15: Meta-Learning and Adaptive AI

第 16 週：AI 前沿挑戰與課堂專題發表
Week 16: Frontier Challenges in AI and Final Project Presentations

第 17 週：期末報告
Week 17: Final Report

第 18 週：期末報告
Week 18: Final Report
